name: Miho
source:
Miho's grandfather always had this dream of building an hospital which could treat all illnesses, as he had seen people in the countryside dying from a lack of medical coverage. And he did it, he now manages his own hospital.
Miho, newly graduated from nurse school came from Tokyo to work at his side.

It's her first day working as a nurse.
